name: ektie
description: Finding customers is the hard part. Ektie runs your go-to-market work in one place: CRM, email and sequences, forms, social posts, ads and Creative Studio, with an AI team you can hire. Connect your assistant to work in Ektie directly, with the same checks your team works under.

interface.shortDescription: Run your CRM, outreach and ads
interface.longDescription: Ektie is a CRM and go-to-market platform for B2B teams: contacts and companies, email and sequences, forms, social posts, Google, Meta and Reddit ads, and Creative Studio for ad images and short videos, with an AI team you can hire to keep working after you close the tab. This plugin connects Codex to your Ektie workspace so you can work in it directly: search and update records, research accounts and score ICP fit, write and send follow-ups, build and enroll sequences, publish social posts, and build, launch and tune ad campaigns. It follows your Ektie role permissions and the same checks your team works under, and anything that sends, spends or deletes asks you first.
defaultPrompt: How many contacts have been contacted this month?
Research this account, score its ICP fit and add it to the CRM.
Draft follow-ups for contacts who asked for pricing and show me first.
